sentences.text: On 1.31, coordinated leader election allows control plane components to deterministically select a leader, which helps satisfy version skew constraints during cluster upgrades.

citations.quote: Kubernetes 1.31 includes an alpha feature that allows control plane components to deterministically select a leader via coordinated leader election. This is useful to satisfy Kubernetes version skew constraints during cluster upgrades.

gaps: The 1.27 documentation excerpts do not cover coordinated leader election.
